name: SIA Door Supervisor Practice Test
fullName: Level 2 Award for Door Supervisors in the Private Security Industry (SIA licence-linked qualification), multiple-choice exams
outline: SIA door supervision specifications (April 2021, still current Oct 2026) as published in the Pearson BTEC Level 2 Award spec, Issue 2, Sept 2023: Unit 1 MCQ 72 in 110 min, 70%; Unit 2 50 in 75 min, 70%; Unit 3 20 in 30 min, 70%; Unit 4 30 in 45 min, 80%. 172 MCQ in all; per-test counts are 50 x unit share (21/14/6/9), Unit 1 split by learning outcome into 4 categories and Unit 2 into 2.
trainingSets: testSets(7700, 4): one set per mock exam, ids 7701-7704
jurisdiction: England and Wales law for licensing, arrest and force; Scotland and NI flagged as different on the landing
